notes: Each record is one chapter within a word journey, joined by card_id.
Distinct image assignments; candidate does not mean historically contemporaneous or installed.
Retain credit, license link, and explanatory image caption. A modern depiction is illustrative, not evidence of ancient culture.
Source rectangles are normalized [left, top, right, bottom], applied as CSS crops without changing source pixels.
Downloaded files are source-provided previews where available; full-resolution originals remain linked.
Strong indicates clear subject at thumbnail size. Conditional means it benefits from a caption, has fine detail, or uses indirect context; it is not a missing file.
Image context notes prevent later or foreign depictions being mistaken for artifacts from the chapter’s word date and culture.
